title: Tell it like a film
text: Tell it like a film to someone seeing it the first time. Before the guest's detail, give the viewer a taste of the context (who these people are, where, what happened between them), then go into the story. Never open a story part on a line that only makes sense if you already know the case. Rule 1's "get in fast" means no warm-up, not no context.

source.heading: Story first, then the speech (user, on YT agent v1, 2026-11-25)
